correctness.rationale: Verified all four input-matrix similarity types, their GL2 conjugacy class sizes via centralizer orders, and all possible Hom_{k[t]} dimensions. The all-q result is a mathematical proof, not inference from experiments.

value.rationale: Determines a natural complete nullity and prescribed-right-hand-side solution-size profile of the smallest genuinely nontrivial Sylvester matrix family. The forbidden nullity-three stratum and all-characteristic polynomial frequencies sharpen the classical binary invertibility condition; exact solvability probability is useful as a uniform finite-field benchmark.
